method: ACS total allocation weighted by the within-tract 2020 Census block population pattern
analysisGeometry: Full Census TIGERweb ACS2024 tracts, January 1, 2024 vintage; not Living Atlas water-erased display polygons

liveDisplayedZoneChecks.reason: No usable populated 2020 pattern in a partial overlap; newer allocation remains unknown

limitations: Five-year survey estimates are not current occupants or confirmed evacuees.
2020 population weights cannot identify later development or movement within tracts.
Age and PIO topic values remain whole-tract context.
No phone runtime test or statistical accuracy claim for the zone allocation.
Future ACS periods require matching analysis-boundary configuration.
